pages.text: A band's faith in you runs from 0 to 55, and a new band starts at $(l)35$(). For its first $(l)ten minutes$() it lets the small things go - only a real failing costs you - unless it is the dry season, when nothing is let go, and every loss counts for more.$(br2)It rises when you share food, groom, play, keep your word and give them what they need.

$(l)Below 30$() they want to see you do better, and turn down half your trades. While it is 21 to 29, $(o)I'll do better$() appears under $(k:hominin_evolution.social), Social - once.$(br)$(l)20 and under$(): no trades at all.$(br)$(l)10 and under$(): one more failing and they drive you out.$(br2)$(l)40 and up$() they listen and stand firm, but every gain is harder won. $(l)50$(): they would do anything for you (55 at most).

$(l)Needs$() are not wants. There is at most one at a time, said out loud, and the one in need glows: a mother-to-be needs a real meal, someone laid up needs a good stone to work. You have ten minutes - hand it over with $(o)Here, take this$().$(br2)Met, the band saw you put them first. Ignored, they will not forget it.

They keep count. Food handed over, things taken from their packs and errands run are $(l)taking$(); anything you hand them, and every want or need met, is giving back. Take far more than you give and they tell you - and then it costs you.$(br2)Carry $(l)20 or more$() food and they ask you to split it. Someone of theirs carrying that much splits it too. Hold it and choose Food, $(o)Split what I'm holding between you$().

From erectus, some do not care what the band thinks. They steal, hoard, never give, teach the young nothing, and now and then start a fight. A band coming apart grows more of them.$(br2)A band can stand up to them: $(l)Nobody lords it over the rest$(), in the Culture tab, or $(o)Shun them$() under Social - and they bend, or they go.
